edit_text_prompt:
✏️ Send the new text as a message.
The current text is below: tap it to copy, edit, and send it back.
edit_cancelled_other: Previous edit cancelled, here's that draft again:
which_images: 🖼 Which images should be posted? Tap a number to include or exclude it.
daily_prompt: 📰 Daily summary time. Want to see what got posted today?
add_channel_prompt:
➕ Send the channel's @username or t.me link, or forward any message from it.
The reader account needs to be able to see it — public channels get joined automatically.
channel_not_found:
❌ Couldn't find that channel ({error}).
Send an @username, t.me link, or forward a message from it.
channel_last_one: Can't remove the last channel — add another first
prompt_header: 📝 Current writing style is below (this is the bot's whole personality/tone).
edit_style_prompt: ✏️ Send the new writing style as a message. It replaces the current one entirely, and applies to the next post — no restart needed.
style_updated: ✅ Writing style updated. Applies to the next post — no restart needed.
daily_on:
⏰ Daily summary: ON
Prompt sent at {hour}:00 UTC
daily_hour_prompt: 🕒 Send the hour (0-23) in UTC for the daily prompt.
daily_hour_invalid: Send a number 0-23 (that's the UTC hour).
daily_hour_set: ✅ Daily summary time set to {hour}:00 UTC.
credits_line: Made by LunaTheWolf (@Vov4ik3), built with Claude (Anthropic) 🤍
about_text:
ℹ️ About

Channel Rewriter watches Telegram channels, rewrites new posts with Gemini, and posts them to your channel or group.

Made by LunaTheWolf (@Vov4ik3)
Built with Claude (Anthropic)

github.com/Vov4ik3/Channel-rewriter-bot
ai_choose_prompt: 🤖 Which AI should rewrite your posts?
ai_model_prompt: ✏️ Send the model name to use (current: {current}).
ai_server_prompt: 🌐 Send the local server's OpenAI-compatible base URL (current: {current}). Example: http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.
ai_setup_gemini:
🔑 Gemini needs an API key. Free, no card needed:
1. Go to aistudio.google.com
2. Click "Get API key"
3. Send the key here as a message.
ai_setup_openai:
🔑 OpenAI needs an API key (paid, no free tier):
1. Go to platform.openai.com/api-keys
2. Create a new key
3. Send it here as a message.
ai_setup_deepseek:
🔑 DeepSeek needs an API key (paid, cheap):
1. Go to platform.deepseek.com
2. Create a new key
3. Send it here as a message.
ai_setup_claude:
🔑 Claude needs an API key (paid, no free tier):
1. Go to console.anthropic.com
2. Create a new key
3. Send it here as a message.
